description: This file is a TypeScript source file implementing a Vite plugin for Playwright component testing, including build management, dependency resolution, and server control.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates a Playwright test runner plugin for Vite, managing server setup, teardown, and dependency handling.

methods.name: buildBundle
methods.description: Builds or retrieves the Vite bundle, managing component info, dependencies, and build state.

methods.name: checkSources
methods.description: Checks if source files have changed based on timestamps to determine if rebuild is needed.

methods.name: checkNewComponents
methods.description: Detects if new components have been added compared to previous build info.

methods.name: vitePlugin
methods.description: Creates a Vite plugin for transforming files and collecting dependencies during build.

methods.name: collectViteModuleDependencies
methods.description: Recursively collects dependencies of a module in the Vite build context.
